notification.bash: cmux_cli="${CMUX_BUNDLED_CLI_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$cmux_cli" ] || [ ! -x "$cmux_cli" ]; then cmux_cli="$(command -v cmux 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi; if [ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && [ "$CMUX_COPILOT_HOOKS_DISABLED" != "1" ] && [ -n "$cmux_cli" ]; then { if [ -n "${CMUX_SOCKET_PATH:-}" ]; then "$cmux_cli" --socket "$CMUX_SOCKET_PATH" hooks copilot stop; else "$cmux_cli" hooks copilot stop; fi; } || echo '{}'; else echo '{}'; fi
